decisions.reason: After two years this organic poultry snack remains a niche but credible adjacency, so we keep it because the carrying cost is modest even though the option value from waiting is starting to diminish.
Bio Fleischwurst is a very close extension of the firm's core sausage business and should be inexpensive to support, so we keep it while another year of sales clarifies its organic potential.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line matches the push into organic and more ingredient-conscious cold cuts, but its several variants use more assortment space and could be pruned if turnover stays weak.

Organic herb-coated salami is a low-risk test near the firm's salami base, so we keep it, though its more specialized flavor profile makes withdrawal somewhat more likely than for the most standard organic items.
